feeds.title: MEN'S NON-NO Blog
feeds.description: MEN'S NON-NO is the male fashion magazine by Tokyo-based Shueisha. MEN'S NON-NO features an extensive array of menswear styles ranging from street, contemporary and high fashion, as well as more formal attire, making it appealing to a broad audience regardless of age and interest.

feeds.title: Junky Style Blog
feeds.description: The Junky Style Blog brings you information on vintage fashion and much more. Junky Style is a woodsy, lo-tech clothing shop located in Ryogoku, Tokyo, featuring US & domestic vintage casual fashions & Hawaiian shirts.

feeds.title: Fudge.jp » Fashion
feeds.description: Fudge is where you can read the latest fashion news and fashion snaps from London, Paris, and Tokyo, fashion feature articles, columns, shopping information, and lots of other fun information. FUDGE.jp is a web media for adult girls who love fashion and culture. We will deliver sweet and rich information that you can incorporate the essence of FUDGE into your daily life.

feeds.title: La Carmina Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning Gothic fashion, subcultures, and female travel blog. La Carmina is a travel TV host and author who blogs about alternative, punk, Goth, clothing, hair and style, and Harajuku Japan youth underground culture. La Carmina's mission is to showcase underground and fringe subcultures in a positive light and encourage meaningful, offbeat, compassionate travel.

feeds.title: Kawaii Babe Blog

Kawaii Babe is a fully international kawaii fashion brand dedicated to selling the cutest aesthetic clothing & accessories to cuties around the entire globe!

feeds.title: Fashionsnap
feeds.description: Fashionsnap is an information site that covers a variety of topics including beauty, business, art, culture, and sports, with a focus on fashion-related events. Since its opening in 2005, Fashionsnap has been the largest in Japan and functions as a center of fashion information. It will create the future of fashion by gathering all people involved in fashion and sharing information that is born every day.

feeds.title: Japan Nakama » Fashion
feeds.description: Japan's influence on global fashion and beauty cannot be denied. In modern times we have come to associate Japanese fashion with being unique but also familiar and Japanese beauty or J-Beauty is certified in both quality and technology. Japan Nakama is an online lifestyle and culture magazine. We explore our love for Japan by writing about food, art, fashion and style and anime.
